Messages.Author: Guru
Messages.Body:
Hi,

1) Is DotB stackable?
2) Do damage from DotB is applied to the opposing vampire even if he
strikes combat end?

Thanks in advance,
Gurus

Messages.Author: Archibald Zimonyi
Messages.Body:
> 1) Is DotB stackable?

From the online card description:

Drawing Out the Beast [Jyhad, V:TES, SW, FN]
Cardtype: Combat
Discipline: Animalism
Only usable before range is determined on the first round.
[ani] During this combat, opposing vampire gets +1 strength, but he or
she cannot use maneuvers to maneuver to long range, cannot use presses
to end combat and cannot use equipment. A vampire may play only one
Drawing Out the Beast each combat.
[ANI] As above, and the opposing vampire takes 1 damage during the press
step each round. This damage cannot be prevented.

Thus the answer to your question is no.

> 2) Do damage from DotB is applied to the opposing vampire even if he
> strikes combat end?
>

No, if combat ends by a strike there is no press step, thus no damage.

Archibald Zimonyi
Malkavian Prince of Gothenburg
